ghidra: read-only: no renames, comments, prototypes, function creation or saves
headline: The authored `Cruise` carries no parameters. It latches the unit's standing order and heading into the weapon director's cruiseIsHeading / cruiseSteerOrHeading / cruiseThrust (00835AC0 through 00835E17) and re-applies them every AI step (009E1170). The executable runs its float math at a 24-bit mantissa because CreateDevice omits D3DCREATE_FPU_PRESERVE.

x87.conclusion: The image leaves the process at 027Fh / 53-bit. Because D3DCREATE_FPU_PRESERVE is absent from both CreateDevice calls, d3d9.dll lowers the precision-control field to 24 bits for the life of the device, so 00825F20 runs at control word 007Fh, a 24-bit mantissa, round to nearest, all exceptions masked. The 24-bit write is inside d3d9.dll; no run log was taken.

probe.model: the hand order stands for N steps, then cruise_command_begin_00835e17 latches it and cruise_ordered_values_009e1170 drives every later step
probe.substitute: the heading arm issues a zero rudder because 009E0040 and the heading controller behind it are not reconstructed; a ship already on its latched heading is steered with a zero rudder either way, and a Cruise latched off-heading is not covered
probe.speed_setting: left disabled (-1.0f, the value 009E11C6 stores) because the producer of *(unit+73Ch)+24h is unread
probe.run: 280 steps of 0.05 s = 14.0 s, class-built hull body (column B)
probe.finding: The latch reproduces the standing order exactly in both arms, to the last printed digit. Latching before the ring has slewed (slew_a 8.0/s, slew_b 2.0/s from 00812F84/00812F8C) captures thrust 0 and the ship never moves, so in the shipped game something puts a throttle on the mission's 32 Cruise ships before or instead of the latch.

uncertainties: The heading arm of 009E1170 is projected as hold-the-latched-heading and the probe issues a zero rudder for it; 009E0040 and the controller behind it are unread.

Four callees still enter the projection with unread bodies: 0071E2E0, 0071E7F0, 00521E70 and [director+34h]->vtable[140h]. 0071C0C0, 0071D780, 0071D6D0, 00836040, 0071E200, 007788B0, 006E38E0, 009DFFB0, 009E0040 and 009DBF90 were read in a second pass; 009229F0, 007AC9D0, 00927F10, 00605070 and 009DA4E0 are unread one level down.
Which MT_GAMEUNIT_SETCMD fields 0071C930 and 0071CA30 put on the wire, and in what quantisation, was not read.
[00E0AF1C], the default routing flags for the MT_COMMAND hop, is still unread at run time; the second hop overrides it with 7.
The 24-bit x87 write is performed by d3d9.dll and is documented API behaviour, not an instruction in this image; no run log was taken.
No number in this report was taken from the running game; the probe rows are the reconstruction driving itself.
